notablePrerequisites: Emry and Orcish Mechanics do not have summoning sickness.
description:
Tap Orcish Mechanics, sacrificing Fountain of Youth to deal 2 damage to any target.
Tap Emry, targeting Fountain of Youth.
Cast Fountain of Youth.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, allowing you to loot.
Jeskai Ascendancy triggers, untapping all creatures you control and giving them +1/+1 until end of turn.
Repeat.
